title: SWF compile: autoSize text field property not in model or emitted
description: autoSize is not in the Symbol/DisplayObject model (packages/core/src/model/types.ts), not decoded from FLA binary (flash8-binary.ts readCPicText), and not emitted in DefineEditText (packages/swf/src/text.ts). In SWF, DefineEditText flag bit 14 is AutoSize. Fix: (1) add autoSize?: 'none'|'left'|'center'|'right' to the text field model type, (2) decode from FLA binary CPicText — find the byte that controls auto-resize behavior, (3) emit in DefineEditText flag bit 14 when autoSize is not 'none'. The SWF spec only has a boolean AutoSize flag; the direction (left/center/right) affects alignment but the SWF flag is just on/off.
